speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Hyperinflation of the lungs, flattened diaphragms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the X-ray results; the hyperinflation and flattened diaphragms strongly suggest an obstructive process. Has your breathing difficulty worsened over time, and do you experience wheezing or coughing fits that improve after using a rescue inhaler? Additionally, have you noticed any smoking history or exposure to dust and chemicals?

speaker: Patient
text: Yes, the shortness of breath has definitely gotten worse over the last few years, and I often wheeze, though I don't currently have a rescue inhaler to help with it. I have been a smoker for about 20 years, working as a delivery driver, so I've been exposed to a lot of dust and fumes on the job. However, hospital policy during the current surge is to avoid non-essential labs. Cardiac diagnosis must be made from clinical evaluation only.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) with likely chronic bronchitis and emphysema components.
